title: Album Cover with Portrait and Handwritten Text
coreRelationships: The man's profile is the central focus, occupying the majority of the frame.
The textured background provides a soft, painterly context for the portrait.
The vertical text acts as a strong left-side border and visual counterpoint to the portrait.
The warm, muted color palette unifies the portrait and background.
reuseFormula: Generate a textured, warm-toned background. Create a digitally painted and sketched portrait of a man in profile, facing left, as the central subject. Overlay custom-lettered, all-caps, dark brown text vertically along the left edge, ensuring a handwritten, brush-stroke aesthetic.
